description: This file implements the NotesList activity for an Android note-taking application. It displays a list of notes, handles creation, editing, copying, deleting notes, and integrates with system features like clipboard and context menus. It utilizes loaders to asynchronously fetch data from a content provider and manages user interactions through options and context menus.

classes.name: NotesList
classes.description: An Android activity that displays a list of notes, supporting CRUD operations, context menus, and integration with other note app features.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the list adapter, and starts the loader to asynchronously load note data.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates the options menu with actions like add and paste, and integrates additional applications' intents.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Enables or disables menu items based on clipboard content and list state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of menu items like adding new notes or pasting from clipboard.

methods.name: onCreateContextMenu
methods.description: Creates a context menu for long-pressed list items, offering options like open, copy, and delete.

methods.name: onContextItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selected context menu actions such as opening, copying the note URI to clipboard, or deleting the note.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on list items, opening notes for editing or returning selected note URIs.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to asynchronously query the provider for notes data.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Swaps in the loaded cursor into the adapter to display notes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears the cursor from the adapter when loader is reset.
